issues.title: Pin the review baseline and distinguish the three variants
issues.finding: The retained October 17 review pins code b3fb0b35, head 10cb763b and current app 75d06cb. The third branch targets a future contract, not a newer firmware claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain exact source SHAs and dates in branch documentation.
Do not describe the October 4 AWS export as a fresh live audit or 1.3.11 as finalized-rep capable.
issues.resolution: Source/branch intent is documented locally; no device behavior is certified.

issues.title: Device-side image authenticity and OTA authorization
issues.finding: Reviewed 1.3.11 accepts unrestricted OTA GATT writes and caller-provided MD5; secure boot/signed-app verification are off. An app login and download hash do not authorize the device writer.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree and independently implement device-side authenticity/authorization controls outside these app branches.
Demonstrate rejection of unauthorized, unsigned and wrong-target images under the agreed design.

issues.title: Post-activation health and recovery
issues.finding: The inactive slot protects a transfer but automatic boot rollback is disabled; a valid image that crashes can require USB recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Document and bench-test the actual post-activation recovery procedure.
If rollback is chosen, implement and validate boot health/rollback separately; determine bootloader/partition USB requirements.
Remove any blanket promise that every failed update leaves the device operational.

issues.title: Supply a reproducible, uniquely identified update artifact
issues.finding: No signed-off release artifact or source-to-binary bench evidence is supplied by these app scaffolds. Version reuse cannot identify an exact running build.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain immutable padded application .gz, source/build identity, board/partition target, compressed/inflated sizes and both MD5 values.
Pin dependencies, build the intended target and verify its image; do not use factory ZIP, bootloader or partition files for BLE OTA.
Use a unique verified target version/build; do not infer an exact build from a reused version string.

issues.title: Run the physical iOS/Android OTA and workout acceptance matrix
issues.finding: Host fixtures and source review do not prove native Bluetooth timing, sensor behavior, power safety or installed firmware.
acceptanceCriteria: Test each band slot on real iOS/Android through download, transfer, verification, reboot and rediscovery.
Exercise packet loss, duplicate/reordered ACKs, low battery/USB, background/lock/process death, Bluetooth loss, low/changed MTU and power loss at each stage.
Validate post-update start/readiness, two sets, mid-rep hold, STOP, disconnect, Mountain Climbers placement and sensor/battery recovery.
Retain artifact/device/app identifiers and actual results, including failures.

issues.title: Add release/attempt services with authorization and truthful acknowledgements
issues.finding: The October 4 AWS snapshot has no OTA release/attempt model and identifies missing caller ownership checks and success-looking rep resolver responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-read live AWS before designing migrations; reuse the existing stack and deployed band_metrics/tut/velocity fields.
Implement authorized immutable release distribution and idempotent attempt state in staging if cloud distribution is selected.
Return confirmed stored values and errors; test cross-user denial, identical retry, conflict and partial-to-complete merge.
Make installed-version observation distinct from transfer completion.

issues.title: Validate foreground lifecycle, navigation and shared BLE exclusion
issues.finding: The shared operation gate, acknowledged workout-command writes, and foreground/lifecycle protections are implemented. Native navigation, background/reconnect timing and cross-screen exclusion still require device validation.
acceptanceCriteria: All app workout/Identify/update commands and connection actions respect one shared update lock.
Keep pending workout data before OTA; prevent starting during capture.
Validate navigation/screen lock/background behavior in native builds and show interrupted/unknown outcomes honestly.
Check completion only after selected-device rediscovery and target identity verification.
issues.resolution: App protections implemented; full acceptance remains open until native/hardware evidence is recorded.
implementedScope: Shared BLE operation gate excludes OTA and workout/Identify operations and guards connection actions.
Workout writes wait for firmware return-code acknowledgement instead of treating a GATT write as success.
Foreground/lifecycle and updater-owned reconnect handling are implemented.
openAcceptance: Run real iOS/Android navigation, screen lock/background, connection loss and simultaneous-action tests.
Verify retained workout data, unknown-outcome recovery and selected-device rediscovery across app interruption.

issues.title: Bootstrap older bands through an approved service process
issues.finding: 1.3.11 is the first reviewed firmware with image transfer; read-only OTA version service on 1.3.9 does not provide the initial update path.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect presence of the required OTA characteristics, not a version string alone.
Show service-update-required for older or unsupported devices.
Document and test USB bootstrap on the intended hardware outside these app branches; do not execute it as part of this work.

issues.title: Integrate and verify the 1.3.11 OTA state machine
issues.finding: The 1.3.11 OTA transport is implemented and its 13 mocked protocol tests pass. This is host state-machine evidence; native timing, hardware recovery and customer release acceptance remain open.
acceptanceCriteria: Encode the exact 22-byte little-endian START; distinguish status constants from ACK values.
Use fixed payload P, window 32, bounded sequence, distinct compressed/image MD5s, and recovery without waiting for an unspecified final ACK.
Retain selected-device identity; cancellation stops being offered before finalization; resolve reconnect state before a new START.
Run protocol unit tests and native integration tests without adding firmware changes.
issues.resolution: Implemented with 13/13 mocked tests passing. The issue remains open for native/hardware acceptance.
implementedScope: Exact 22-byte START, status-before-ACK parsing, fixed-payload/window flow control and bounded sequence guards.
Distinct compressed/image MD5s, retransmission/reconnect logic and no requirement for a final ACK.
Finalization cancellation barrier, selected-device target-version verification and scoped monitor cleanup.
openAcceptance: Run the transport in actual iOS/Android builds with a validated release artifact and both band slots.
Complete physical loss/background/power/recovery acceptance; do not infer signed-image support or rollback from passing mocks.

issues.title: Validate the implemented gated band firmware screen
issues.finding: The band firmware route/UI, default-off pilot gate, local file validator, device identity checks and battery preflight are implemented. Native end-to-end operation and release-service acceptance remain open.
acceptanceCriteria: Show selected band, source/target version, eligible artifact and charge status.
Separate transfer, verification, restart, verified completion, retry and service-required states.
Default the pilot off; do not advertise customer readiness merely because a source branch exists.
Leave other current app behavior visible and document retained issues.
issues.resolution: App route, guarded UI and preflight implementation are present; 8/8 artifact helper tests pass. Native/hardware acceptance is not complete.
implementedScope: Band firmware route and updater UI with explicit transfer/verification/restart/outcome states.
OTA pilot defaults off; selecting or starting an update remains gated.
Local artifact validation and device identity/capability/battery checks before transfer.
openAcceptance: Validate the file-picker, permissions, screen/lifecycle behavior and target identity handling on actual iOS/Android builds.
Provide an approved release artifact and production distribution/eligibility policy; the local pilot UI does not establish a release catalog.
Keep device-side authenticity, rollback and physical verification open under the shared firmware issues.

testEvidence.kind: host artifact tests using application dependencies with independent Node hashes

issues.title: Retain and document current measurement and set-boundary limits
issues.finding: OTA integration does not fix 1.3.11's rep-edge/final-TUT ordering or all partial-rep reset state. Those remain measurement dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not label cached legacy rep-edge values as immutable finalized measurements.
Document existing best-effort capture limits in this minimal branch.
Keep the firmware recommendations separate and verify regression of existing set/rep behavior after OTA.

issues.title: Pin native dependencies and retain build evidence
issues.finding: Host helper tests do not establish that the native app builds or runs the updater with the installed BLE library.
acceptanceCriteria: Pin the tested dependency lockfile without replacing integration identifiers.
Record successful native builds and permission handling for supported Android/iOS versions.
Retain current-app regression evidence and publish no production build from this task.
